name: openspec-gateway
title: OpenSpec Gateway
summary: Consume normalized requirement input, generate OpenSpec files, and enforce deterministic validation, scoring, diff, and version gates.

use_when: Generating an OpenSpec file from normalized requirements
Generating an OpenSpec file from an ado-gateway handoff or other normalized requirement contract
Validating OpenSpec structure, acceptance criteria, or governance
Producing governance artifacts for OpenSpec changes
avoid_when: The task is fetching raw Azure DevOps data
The task is pure code implementation with no spec output
The task is unrelated documentation work
The task is drafting a freeform non-OpenSpec spec from ambiguous input before normalization
